target: SiroinoSotai v1.0 PC; pattern dimensions, ease, shape-key fit, and motion are unverified.

requiredPatternComponents.reason: Directly observed in the four-view generated concept: fitted ivory long-sleeve jacket, high collar, one diagonal overlapping chest panel, and small quilted elbow panels. Exact seams, closures, ease, scale, and fit remain unverified.

V9 trial shortens the overskirt panel depth to 95 mm and the flat half-width to 235 mm, retaining the waist edge. It aims to expose the fitted under-shorts and reduce pointed rear fold tails; pleat count, panelization, attachment, and fit remain unverified hypotheses.

V14 changes the paired lower-rise endpoint from local pattern Y -0.160 m to -0.180 m and expands the lower leg-wrap outer bound from 0.220 m to 0.280 m, tapering to the existing 0.252 m thigh bound. The four canonical panel IDs and mirrored front/back rise seam pairs remain. This is a structural coverage trial after V13 hip-anchored weights showed no visible crouch/sit improvement; 2D panel validity, neutral coverage, ease, fit, pose and runtime remain unverified.

researchTrial.method: Validate hash-bound construction inputs, manufacture an editable 3D prototype, and directly review its rendered appearance before completion.
researchTrial.review: V14 increases the lower four-panel shorts wrap width at the crotch end. It is a structural 3D placement hypothesis after V13 weight changes did not visibly improve crouch/sit inner-thigh coverage; ease, clearance and motion remain unverified.

bodyProfileEvidence.evidenceBoundary: Neutral and repository-defined Large body cross-sections only. Reuse is bound to the same byte-identical SiroinoSotai PC FBX; waistline selection, garment ease, collar circumference, shape-key coverage, fit, and motion remain unapproved.

releaseBoundary: 3D prototypes require prototypeReadiness. Rendered visualAppearanceReview, fit, runtime, and customer release evidence remain unverified and mandatory before release.

clothSimulation.evidence: Bounded neutral cloth experiment on canonical sewn panels; fit and motion acceptance remain unverified.
clothSimulation.reason: A separate inner-thigh insert remained visibly exposed and did not close crouch/sit coverage. This candidate removes the insert and directly joins the paired front and back lower-rise seams; skirt cloth evidence is separately rebound only for unchanged skirt construction. No shorts coverage, fit or pose acceptance is claimed.

pleated-overskirt.evidenceBoundary: Direct bounded native Blender Cloth solve on the current sewn prototype; component bending stiffness and exact source/pose/pattern/body hashes recorded. Diagnostic geometry only; no fit, pose, or visual acceptance.

frontClosure.construction: Right-front hem crosses center by 40 mm in local pattern coordinates, tapering to zero at the upper opening; left front supplies continuous underlay to center. Existing shoulder and side seams retain their common vertices.
frontClosure.evidenceBoundary: Corrects a cut-away lower front into an overlap hypothesis and adds a shallow clasp bridge raycast-bound across both canonical layers. 40 mm extension, 2 mm spacing and clasp dimensions are design hypotheses, not avatar-approved ease. Opening force, fabric strain, fit, appearance and runtime remain unverified.

prototypeWeightRegions.evidenceBoundary: Provisional pelvis/leg surface window extended to Z 0.42 m for a revised prototype hem near the measured 0.4144 m knee landmark. The window and nearest-surface weights remain hypotheses; no fit, deformation, penetration or runtime acceptance.

weightProfiles.evidenceBoundary: Prototype weighting hypothesis bound to the measured Lilac skirt mesh: current side hem vertices average 0.963 ipsilateral thigh weight, while 67 centerline hem vertices average 0.970 combined thigh weight and 0.030 Hips. Fade centerline influence to Hips and cap lateral hem thigh influence at 0.65; retain 0.15 thigh weight at the waistband. Intended to reduce opposing thigh pull and raised/curling flaps; no pose, fit, penetration or runtime acceptance is granted.

V13 prototype hypothesis responding to V12's continued crouch/sit inner-thigh exposure: give the medial 80 mm band zero thigh influence so the joined crotch remains Hips-anchored, then fade toward the side-thigh profile over 65 mm while retaining the 0.85 side hem cap. This tests a wider pelvis-supported bridge across the four sewn panels; no neutral coverage, fit, ease, pose, penetration, Shape Key, or runtime acceptance is claimed.

shapeKeyPostprocess.reason: This checkpoint-bound panel-sewn Blender prototype does not author product corrective shape keys, so the optional maxwilso smoothing operator is not part of this build. This declaration does not establish avatar Shape Key fit or acceptance; those remain unverified release blockers.
